# BGMI Name Generator — Esports Nickname & Symbol Studio

> A high-performance, client-side utility for generating Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) and PUBG Mobile in-game nicknames with Unicode typography, popular esports clan symbols (亗, ☬, ꧁, 彡, 々), and an automated 14-character length validator.

## Project Overview

- **Canonical URL**: https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/bgminamegenerator/
- **Author**: Ahmed Elazab
- **Primary Technology**: Pure Client-Side JavaScript, Unicode Mathematical Alphanumeric Transformations
- **License**: Open Source / Free Gaming Utility

## Core Features & Mechanics

1. **Esports Clan Symbols & Formatting**:
   - Generates tested, verified symbols compatible with Unreal Engine 4 in-game rendering without triggering replacement boxes or question marks.
   - Symbols supported: Old Turkish Crown (亗), Khanda (☬), Japanese Shime and Noma (〆, 々), East Asian Patriarch (父), Javanese Wings (꧁ ꧂), and Lightning (⚡).

2. **14-Character Length Validator**:
   - Live character length tracker measuring UTF-16 code units and Unicode glyph bounds against BGMI's strict 14-character ceiling to prevent in-game truncation errors.

3. **Unicode Mathematical Typographic Styles**:
   - Mathematical Bold, Fraktur/Gothic, and Small Caps alphanumeric transformations.
   - Hangul Filler (`ㅤ` U+3164) invisible space insertion for spacebar-restricted in-game inputs.

4. **100% Client-Side Privacy**:
   - All string transformations execute locally in browser memory. Zero player names or queries are transmitted across external servers.

## Technical Specifications & Performance

- **Performance**: 100% Lighthouse score, zero external Google Fonts (using native system font stack), zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS = 0.000).
- **Accessibility & Contrast**: Full WCAG AAA color contrast compliance, sequentially descending heading hierarchy (`h1` → `h2` → `h3`), and accessible form labels.
- **Copy Mechanism**: One-click clipboard copy with visual feedback toast notifications.
